# PR #3132: Patch: the learned evaluation reads what a card is, not only its id, so a card it never trained on still counts

Closes #3112

## What changed

**Features by what a card is (R3112000, `FEATURES_VERSION` 3).** Some cards get an id key in the learned evaluation's sparse features: units on either board, cards in the seat's own hand, and backrow cards the seat can read. Each of those cards now also gets keys for what it is, in its zone and on its side:
- `<zone>.type:<side>:<type>`: its running face's type (`card_type_of_face`, §5.2).
- `<zone>.cost:<side>:<n>`: its printed cost, read with R65's `query_cost`.
- `<zone>.tag:<side>:<tag>`: one per tag.
- `<zone>.kw:<side>:<keyword>`: one per keyword of its running face, weighted as the dense keyword counts are.
- `<zone>.attack:<side>:<n>` and `<zone>.health:<side>:<n>`: its running face's printed attack and health.
- `<zone>.face:<side>:Radiant`: when it is Radiant.

Numbers are clamped to 0..`ATTRIBUTE_TOP` (10). The keys are added only where an id key is already added, so the enemy's hand and a face-down backrow card still give nothing (R185). The existing `r1006000_r185_…` test now covers these keys too. The dense layout does not change.

**The shipped network still plays exactly as before (R3112001).** The shipped network (generation 13) was fitted on version 2, so it has no row for any of the new keys, and a key with no row is no input to it. A new `FEATURES_READ_SINCE = 2` lets a network fitted on version 2 or 3 ship. R1010000's test now accepts that range and still checks the dense layout. A change to the dense layout, or to what an existing key means, must raise `FEATURES_READ_SINCE`.

**Staleness signal (R3112002).** `cargo jackioh positions` now adds `cards`, `unknownCards` and `unknownShare` to its one JSON line. `unknownShare` is the share of card copies its rows name whose id the compiled-in network has no row for. A Radiant card in hand counts once, through its `hand` key. The learn lane keeps that line as `positions.json`, and `jq '.counts.replayed'` still reads it. The code is `unknown_cards` and `Learned::known_card_ids` in `crates/ai/src/learned.rs`.

Also: three ruling notes plus `spec/pending/3112.md`, one sentence each in R1006000 and R1010000, and updates to `crates/ai/README.md`, `crates/tools/README.md`, `docs/learned-eval.md` (D5, D10), `training/learn.md` and `training/ml/README.md`. No weights or fixtures were edited.

The new tests:
- **`r3112000_a_card_with_no_id_row_…`:** a network with rows for core-011 and its attribute keys moves on core-008, which has no id row. With id keys only its correction is 0; with all keys it is above 0.
- **`r3112001_…`:** with the tiny fixture and with the shipped network, the correction on all of this build's features equals the correction on their id keys alone, bit for bit.

Gate smoke results: random 20/20 (17 needed), greedy 19/20 (10 needed), hard-vs-easy 20/20 (16 needed), and the perf and pinned checks ran. `gate --full` belongs to the daily run and **was not run here**.

To run classify's second stage I built `origin/main` and this work in two detached worktrees, from an unreferenced commit object; no branch or ref moved. Both worktrees are removed. The `internal` result means the AI's self-play logs match main's, which is direct evidence that play is unchanged.

## Measurement (plan step 9)

20 games (`selfplay --seed plan-3112`) folded with `positions --every reply` gave 223 rows:

- **`unknownShare` is 0.503** (2,749 card copies, 1,384 with no id row). About half the cards in today's games are unknown to generation 13, which was fitted on catalog v0.3.17; this build is v0.5.11o. That is a strong case for the refit.
- **Memory:** a refit's sparse data grows about 4.6 times. Whether the owner's PC can hold a 100,000-game export is for a person to check.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **No retrain in this PR.** A refit needs the lane's roughly 40-hour export. When the export's build writes other features than this tree's, `retrain.sh` folds with this tree's build, so the next run fits version 3 by itself. I rejected relabeling `weights.json` as version 3, because it would misstate what the network was fitted on. I rejected keeping version 2, because it would defeat the loader's guard against mixing versions.
- **The signal lives in `positions`, not `gate`.** The gate's games are never folded. I rejected a census of the whole catalog, because it counts cards nobody plays.
- **Which attributes:** printed numbers rather than current ones, since the dense features already hold current stats. Rarity and set are left out because the issue does not list them. Attack and health are separate keys, not one combined key.
- **Type is the face's type:** an animated card on the board names the type its face prints, not "Unit".
- **Departure from the plan:** `known_card_ids` returns `Vec<&'a str>`, so `positions.rs` calls `LEARNED.known_card_ids()` directly without the plan's local binding. I also added a small unit test for `card_id_of_key`.

## Worth a second look

- `attributes` runs only right after an id key is added (`features.rs`, `sparse_cards`); that placement is what keeps hidden cards out.
- `unknown_cards` skips `hand_radiant` keys, so a Radiant card in hand counts once.

# #3112: Patch: the learned evaluation reads what a card is, not only its id, so a card it never trained on still counts
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

The game expects hundreds of new cards a month (owner, 2026-11-05). The learned evaluation's sparse features are keyed by card id (`board:<side>:<def_id>`, `hand:…`, `backrow:…`; `crates/ai/src/features.rs`, `sparse_cards`), and `crates/ai/src/learned.rs` silently skips any key the trained table lacks. Until the next retrain, a new card adds nothing past the generic dense features, and that gap grows every month.

High level; the planner decides the details:

- **Cold start:** add features keyed by what a card is (its type, cost, keywords, tags, stats, Radiant), next to or folded into the id-keyed ones, so a new card shares what was learned about similar cards. Bump `FEATURES_VERSION`, and retrain through the training lanes (`training/README.md`, `docs/learned-eval.md`).
- **Staleness signal:** measure the share of cards in play that the shipped model has no row for (in `cargo jackioh gate`, or wherever the training lane reports), so retraining is triggered by that number rather than by a guess.
- The features still come only from `redact(state, seat)`: a hidden card never changes a decision (R185).

### Acceptance

- A test shows a card with no id row in the trained table still moves the evaluation through its attribute features.
- The AI's quality gates hold (`cargo jackioh gate`, and `--full` as the daily run plays it).
- The unknown-card share is printed somewhere a person or the training lane reads it.
- `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` and clippy are green.

Related: #466, #1006 (the learned evaluation and its features).
